title: Black Rock Forest balloon aerial mapping and field GIS
place: Black Rock Forest, Cornwall, New York
program: Three Columbia GIS courses · Fall 2017
contribution: Three GIS courses worked with Public Lab balloon kits, visible-light and modified infrared camera observations, GPS and Collector for ArcGIS field mapping.

context: Balloon aerial mapping was an earlier field-instruction precursor. High winds limited the operation; the retained camera views are source photographs rather than validated maps or quantitative NDVI.
